messages:
Maria (Product): quick convo — we need an "escape hatch" policy for pinned models during the upcoming catalog migration. customers want guarantees + low friction migration options. brainstorm?
Priya (PM): propose 3-tier escape hatch: 1) auto-soft-unpin (default TTL + warnings), 2) retention-credit (90d + sales-applied credit), 3) locked-pin (manual migration w/ ops support).
Kev (Eng): build-wise: soft-unpin is easiest. locked-pin requires an operator override flag and must bypass auto-sweeper. retention-credit just maps to metadata + billing flag.
Sam (Infra): operational concerns: mass-unpin churn could cause routing storms. need rate-limit on unpin actions, and a stagger window per-region. suggest unpin-rate-per-region=50/day and cooldown per-model=2h.
Diego (Sales): customers will negotiate retention-credit as part of renewals. need a standard SKUs: RC-90 (free), RC-180 (paid discount), RC-365 (enterprise). Sales wants a one-pager + migration assistance offer.
Lina (Legal): contracts must reflect opt-ins for locked-pin and retention-credit charges. add clause: "customer acknowledges potential performance variance post-migration" + 30d remediation SLA for regressions.
Maria (Product): user flow draft: customer sees banner -> choose opt-in box (RC-90/180/365) or request locked-pin -> system sets pin.metadata {owner, type, expiry, billing_tag} -> scheduler enforces TTL. add audit trail + email notifications T-30/T-7/T-1.
Kev (Eng): sample metadata fields we need: pinned_by, pin_type, expiry_ts, billing_tag, opt_out_flag. we'll also need a status enum: pinned|pending_unpin|unpin_in_progress|unpinned.
Sam (Infra): telemetry to track: pinned_models_total, pinned_by_tenant, pending_unpin_count, unpin_error_rate, route_switch_latency_p95. important: measure cold-path latency after unpin and roll back if route_switch_latency_p95 > 200ms.
Maria (Product): decides: policy = default soft-unpin TTL 90d; retention-credit productized (90/180/365); locked-pin available only via legal+ops signoff. Can we get a canary rollout?
Kev (Eng): yes. plan: canary with these steps -> 1) implement metadata + UI flag 2) scheduler + rate limits 3) canary cohort = 15 low-risk tenants 4) run warmup + eval 5) expand.
Sam (Infra): warmup approach: traffic mirror for 2h then controlled cutover. prefetch KV + model cache. we need a warmup_job that accepts tenant list and deadline.
Priya (PM): launch criteria checklist: - audit trail present - notif cadence implemented - rate limits enforced - canary bench shows route_switch_latency_p95 < 150ms - eval regressions < 1.5% on tenant promptset - legal templates ready.
Lina (Legal): i will draft contract snippets and liability bullets by Fri EOD.
Diego (Sales): i'll assemble migration-assist SKU and sample comms. share with cs to coordinate outreach.
Kev (Eng): quick perf sample from staging run:
```
model: atlas-lite-1.0-q8
seq: 256
batch: dynamic
route_switch_p95: 132ms
post-unpin-cold-p95: 210ms
```
we need to shave cold-path. cache-warmup recommended; if not possible, raise fallback to sticky-route for 24h.
Sam (Infra): agree. fallback logic: if post-unpin-cold-p95 > 180ms then mark tenant pinned_for_24h_sticky and schedule retry. metric emitted: sticky_fallback_count.
Maria (Product): comms timeline: T-30 email + in-console banner + docs + migration checklist. Anita/CS will own tenant outreach. Diego will own sales offers.
Priya (PM): risks: customers with hard real-time constraints may need locked-pin; need a fast escalation path to ops for manual migration. also beware of billing disputes over retention credits.
Lina (Legal): include escalation SLA: ops ack within 4h for locked-pin requests.
Maria (Product): immediate action items:
- Lina: draft legal snippets & escalation SLA by Fri (owner).
- Kev: add metadata + status enum, prototype warmup hook, bench numbers by Tue (owner).
- Sam: scheduler + rate-limits + metrics, PR by Wed (owner).
- Diego: SKU + comms one-pager, draft by Thu (owner).
- Priya: rollout checklist & canary list (15 tenants) by Mon (owner).
ops-bot: reminder set for 4022300000 "escape-hatch doc review" :bell:
Kev (Eng): adding small eval gate: run semantic similarity eval on tenant promptset; block unpin if embedding-MRR drops > 1.5%.
Sam (Infra): will implement block + notification to cs/escalation channel.
Maria (Product): cool. please post confirmations only. :thumbsup:
